default: Welcome to your expression orchestra: little invitations, surprising sounds, and discoveries of your own.
Follow the current direction and answer with an expression. Listen for congratulations as you make each discovery.
A successful response earns challenge points and a congratulations message.
Each action only needs to be discovered once per player in this challenge.
If another player still needs an action, it returns in a later round. Your completed action stays complete.
Try a comfortable movement and give the camera a moment to recognise it.
Take your time. Unfinished invitations return after the other directions have had a turn.
Each player explores at their own pace. You can keep playing while others try an invitation.
You can keep making music throughout. The points celebrate discoveries; this is not a race.
Your mouth opening shapes the volume. Head movement explores notes and octaves.
Different expressions can give the music a different character. Listen for what changes.
DRUM PERFORMANCE MODE
Turn on Beats to start the backing drums.
Open Drum Pattern and choose the Performance group.
Try Crescendo Build, Bridge Break, Snare Roll Build, Breakdown & Return, or Drop & Impact.
Turn on Performance to let your playing shape the drums.
Play more intensely or open your mouth wider to make the drums hit harder.
Use pitch bend or expressive movement to increase tension and encourage fills and rolls.
Turn Performance off when you want the selected pattern to keep its programmed dynamics.

Turn on Beats to start the backing drums.
Open Drum Pattern and choose the Performance group.
Try Crescendo Build, Bridge Break, Snare Roll Build, Breakdown & Return, or Drop & Impact.
Turn on Performance to let the primary performer's intensity and pitch bend shape the drums.
Play more intensely or open your mouth wider to make performance patterns hit harder.
Use pitch bend or expressive movement to raise tension and encourage fills and rolls.
Rapid Hits adds extra subdivisions where a pattern supports them.

Choose another Drum Pattern at any time to move into a build, bridge, breakdown, roll, or drop.
Scan the QR code at the top right to continue your session on another device.

quickStart: Hello! A little orchestra is waiting to meet you.
Come into the camera view when you are ready. Find a comfortable position.
We offer an invitation; you answer with an expression. That is our call and response.
Each player collects their own discoveries and challenge points.
Once you have done it, it stays complete. We only bring that invitation back for players still exploring it.
There is room to experiment. If an invitation takes longer, we will come back to it in a later round.
No perfect faces required. Take part in whatever way feels comfortable.
If the camera cannot find you, a little more light on your face may help.
